name: Lindsay Corporation
summary: Lindsay Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides water management and road infrastructure products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Irrigation and Infrastructure. The Irrigation segment manufactures and markets center pivot, lateral move, and hose reel irrigation systems, as well as large diameter steel tubing and repair and replacement parts for its irrigation systems and controls under the Zimmatic, FieldNET, and FieldWise brands.
